title: PSV's VAR penalty at the Bernabéu: clear and obvious, or soft?
description:
Real Madrid 5-1 PSV, Champions League league phase, Bernabéu, 24 November 2026. In the first half, Aurélien Tchouaméni goes for the ball inside the box and stands on Sven Mijnans' foot. Play goes on, then VAR sends referee Espen Eskås to the pitchside monitor. He points to the spot and Tchouaméni is booked. Ivan Perišić scores and PSV lead 1-0 at half-time. Real Madrid then score five after the break: Valverde, Bellingham, Mbappé twice and Vinícius.

Under the IFAB VAR protocol, the video assistant may only step in for a "clear and obvious error", and the final decision is always the referee's. One refereeing account on X (Archivo VAR, reported by Goal) says the penalty was right; that is one account, not cross-verified. Reports differ on the minute the penalty was given (28th, 29th or 30th), and that is shown as disputed.

Sources: NL Times, TuFutbolero (citing Mundo Deportivo), Goal, beIN SPORTS, 101 Great Goals, LaLiga match centre, IFAB VAR protocol. Rebuilt from match reports: positions are illustrative, not to scale. No view taken on the officials.
